name: ISO Hemlock
description_html:
Overview

Introducing Not APC556! — a collection of rifles imported from the fictional firearms manufacturer Expedite Firearms in Call of Duty. These rifles are the bigger siblings to the ISO SMG line, offering a mix of power and customization options.

Included Versions:

- .300 BLK

- 5.56x45mm NATO

- .308 Winchester

Each version offers unique performance characteristics, with various barrel, handguard, and stock modifications available.

Note: Due to ammo-based damage mechanics, the 5.56 version with its 600 RPM will have a DPS comparable to the AK-102.

Models and textures are properties of Activision.

Setup and Usage

1. Drop the mod files into the spt folder of your game.

2. Customize rifle options with the available barrel, handguard, and stock modifications.

3. Each variant is modular and can be selectively disabled or customized to your preference.

4. For best compatibility and performance, refer to your mod loader’s documentation.

Permissions and Legal

- When reuploading or sharing this mod, please clearly indicate the author or source.

- Do not distribute files with the .bundle extension (or its variants) from this mod without permission.

- Respect the original creator’s rights as these models and textures are properties of Activision.

Credits

- Special thanks to: Massivesoft
